description: This file contains utility functions for handling files in a file system, including writing if changed, removing files, and removing directories.

methods.name: writeTextFileIfChanged
methods.description: Writes contents to a file only if the contents differ from the current file content, creating the file if it does not exist or differs.

methods.name: removeFileIfExists
methods.description: Deletes a specified file if it exists.

methods.name: removePathIfExists
methods.description: Deletes a directory or path recursively if it exists.
